status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. Independence approved a Chapter 100 tax-abatement/industrial-development plan by 5-2 on 2026-03-02. Nebius announced groundbreaking on 2026-05-12, and official Independence records now show issued footing/foundation permits at 251 N Bly Road on 2026-05-18 and 2026-06-18, plus the July 2026 report lists a $700,659,985 Nebius Data Center - Phase 1 commercial tenant-finish submission at 251 N Bly Road. The June and July city reports also list Nebius switchyard/substation submissions at 301 N Bly Road, and the open-data feed shows a 2026-08-10 footing/foundation permit at 301 N Bly Road. The July 6 moratorium expressly exempts Nebius as already submitted/authorized/approved. No inspection closeout, CO, utility energization, commissioning, or live-service date was located.

capacity_notes: Official city FAQ says the project will require at least 800 MW of power, supplied by a privately financed Independence Power Partners facility at the retired Blue Valley Power Plant site; initial phase 200 MW plus 600 MW at full operation, with 300 MW reserve capacity required by Southwest Power Pool. Third-party and company materials describe the campus as gigawatt-scale / up to 1.2 GW, but 800 MW is the official city-supported project demand retained here.
